chunks: 4914 - It is narrated from Sulaymān ibn Jaʿfar al-Baṣrī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Zayd ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, may the blessings of Allah be upon them, from his father, from al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has disliked for you, O community, twenty-four traits and has forbidden you from them. He has disliked for you idle play in salat (prayer), reminding others of one’s favor in charity, laughing among graves, peering into houses, and looking at the private parts of women.”

And he said: “It causes blindness.” And he disliked speaking during intercourse. And he said: “It causes muteness. And he disliked sleeping before the last ʿIshāʾ prayer, and disliked conversation after the last ʿIshāʾ prayer, and disliked ghusl (ritual bath) under the sky without a waist-wrapper, and disliked intercourse under the sky, and disliked entering rivers without a waist-wrapper.”

And he said: “In the rivers are inhabitants and dwellers from among the angels. And he disliked entering bathhouses except with a waist-wrapper, and disliked speaking between the adhān and the iqāmah in the morning salat (prayer) until the prayer is completed, and disliked riding upon the sea when it is turbulent, and disliked sleeping on a roof that is not enclosed.”

And he said: “Whoever sleeps on a roof that is not enclosed, protection is cleared from him. And he disliked that a man sleep alone in a house, and disliked for a man to approach his wife while she is menstruating. If he approaches her and the child comes out leprous or afflicted with vitiligo, then let him blame none but himself. And he disliked that a man approach a woman while he has had a wet dream until he performs ghusl (ritual bath) from the wet dream that he saw. If he does so and the child comes out insane, then let him blame none but himself.”

And he disliked that a man speak to a leper unless there is between him and him the measure of an arm’s length.” And he said: “Flee from the leper as you flee from a lion. And he disliked urinating on the bank of a flowing river, and disliked that a man relieve himself beneath a fruit-bearing tree that has ripened, or a palm tree that has ripened, meaning borne fruit. And he disliked that a man put on sandals while standing, and disliked that a man enter a dark house unless there is before him a lamp or a fire, and disliked blowing during salat (prayer).”

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةِ: charity, where reproachful reminding of one’s favor is condemned
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), especially proper conduct within worship
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةِ: the commencement call immediately before salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What twenty-four disliked traits did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم warn the Ummah against?
ai.summary: This hadith gathers a wide set of disliked acts in worship, personal conduct, family life, and social etiquette, presenting them as matters Allah has disapproved for the Ummah. It reflects Prophetic guidance on modesty, purity, caution, and disciplined behavior in both devotional and daily settings.
